child.text:
[{"insert":"Cyclist Front Squat

The cyclist front squat pairs raised heels with a front rack hold, and both shift the work almost entirely onto your quads. The front rack also engages your upper back and core to help you stay tall. Keep your elbows high. Follow it with the hamstring walkout to balance out the back of your legs.
"}]
